solution.solution.lua:
Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new(less)
    return setmetatable({ n = 0, less = less or function(a, b) return a < b end }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(v)
    self.n = self.n + 1
    local i = self.n
    self[i] = v
    while i > 1 do
        local p = i // 2
        if not self.less(self[i], self[p]) then break end
        self[i], self[p] = self[p], self[i]
        i = p
    end
end

function Heap:pop()
    if self.n == 0 then return nil end
    local top = self[1]
    self[1] = self[self.n]
    self[self.n] = nil
    self.n = self.n - 1
    local i = 1
    while true do
        local l, r, best = 2 * i, 2 * i + 1, i
        if l <= self.n and self.less(self[l], self[best]) then best = l end
        if r <= self.n and self.less(self[r], self[best]) then best = r end
        if best == i then break end
        self[i], self[best] = self[best], self[i]
        i = best
    end
    return top
end

function Heap:peek() return self[1] end
function Heap:size() return self.n end

function heapsort(list, less)
    local h = Heap.new(less)
    for _, v in ipairs(list) do h:push(v) end
    local out = {}
    while h:size() > 0 do out[#out + 1] = h:pop() end
    return out
end

hints: After `push`, move the new item up while it should come before its parent (`i // 2`); after `pop`, move the item placed at the top down to its better child (lesson 8.01).
Keep the count in a field `n` and use the comparison stored in the heap for every decision, never `<` directly.
unitTests:
test("smallest first", function()
    local h = Heap.new()
    for _, v in ipairs({ 5, 1, 9, 3, 7, 1 }) do h:push(v) end
    check_eq(h:size(), 6)
    check_eq(h:peek(), 1)
    local out = {}
    while h:size() > 0 do out[#out + 1] = h:pop() end
    check_eq(out, { 1, 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 })
    check_eq(h:pop(), nil)
end)

test("a custom order", function()
    local h = Heap.new(function(a, b) return a.p > b.p end)
    h:push({ p = 2, name = "b" }); h:push({ p = 9, name = "urgent" }); h:push({ p = 5, name = "c" })
    check_eq(h:pop().name, "urgent")
    check_eq(h:pop().name, "c")
end)

test("heapsort", function()
    local list = { 4, -2, 8, 0, 8, 3 }
    check_eq(heapsort(list), { -2, 0, 3, 4, 8, 8 })
    check_eq(list, { 4, -2, 8, 0, 8, 3 })
    check_eq(heapsort({ "pear", "fig", "apple" }), { "apple", "fig", "pear" })
    check_eq(heapsort({}), {})
end)

test("many items", function()
    local h = Heap.new()
    for i = 1, 2000 do h:push((i * 7919) % 2003) end
    local last = -1
    for _ = 1, 2000 do
        local v = h:pop()
        check(v >= last)
        last = v
    end
end)
